text:
Saliste of the night

with flowers in the hands.

Vas a salir now of the tumulto of the mundo,

of the babel of lenguas that te nombra.


I that te vi rodeada of hechos primordiales,

Monté in cólera when te mencionaron

in oscuros callejones.

¡how me gustaría that a ola fresca cubriera my mente

that the mundo is trocara in hoja seca,

O in a vilano al wind,

for that I pudiera encontrarte of new

Sola!
